adventurer: Fight monsters, clear dungeons, follow the story. Professions on the side.
artisan: Craft, gather, farm and trade. You level up through your work, monsters leave you alone unless you strike first, and the Artisan’s Road guides you.

smith.name: Blacksmith
smith.blurb: Smelt bars and forge weapons and armor. Masterwork gear sells to every fighter in the realm.
perks: Careful hammer: 15% chance to save a material when forging
Masterwork: forged gear can come out Masterwork (+30% stats)
Guildforging: learn the Guildforged recipes
Double smelt: 25% chance to smelt 2 bars
Grand masterwork: +12% masterwork chance

chef.name: Chef
chef.blurb: Cook dishes that make fighters stronger. The best meals are worth more than gold.
perks: Well seasoned: your meal buffs last 25% longer
Fine hands: +15% chance of fine and masterwork meals
Hearty: eating a dish also heals 20% HP
Two pots: 25% chance to cook two
Signature dish: +10% masterwork chance

baker: Bread, pies and pancakes: 35% chance to make double

farmer.name: Farmer
farmer.blurb: Grow crops and raise animals on your homestead. Feed the whole realm.
perks: Green thumb: crops grow 15% faster
Big harvest: +1 crop every harvest
Good feed: feed lasts twice as long
Bumper crop: 20% chance to double a harvest
Prize livestock: animals produce 25% faster

crops: Crops grow a further 25% faster and always return a seed
ranch: Pens hold 2 more animals and they produce 25% faster

alchemist.name: Alchemist
alchemist.blurb: Pick herbs and brew potions and elixirs that keep adventurers alive.
perks: Steady hand: 20% chance to brew 2 potions
Potency: your healing potions heal 20% more
Herbal eye: 30% chance of an extra herb when picking
Twin brew: 2-potion chance rises to 40%
Philosopher: elixirs last 50% longer

tailor.name: Tailor
tailor.blurb: Spin yarn and cloth and stitch leather and robes for every class.
perks: Neat stitches: 15% chance to save a material
Masterwork: tailored gear can come out Masterwork (+30% stats)
Weaver: learn the wool, linen and hide recipes
Fine thread: +8% masterwork chance
Couturier: +12% masterwork chance

miner.name: Miner
miner.blurb: Dig ore and rare gems from every mountain in the realm. Smiths depend on you.
perks: Strong swing: mine 15% faster
Rich veins: 20% chance of double ore
Gem eye: 2% more chance to find a gem
Mother lode: double ore chance rises to 35%
Deep delver: mine a further 20% faster

delve: Rocks refill twice as fast for you

fisher.name: Fisher
fisher.blurb: Fish every lake, bog and sea. Chefs and alchemists always need your catch.
perks: Patience: fish 15% faster
Double catch: 20% chance of two fish
Sea treasure: 3% chance to reel in a mystery sack
Big catch: double catch rises to 35%
Legend of the lake: fish a further 20% faster

angler: Better fish more often (your Fishing counts as +4)
treasure: Sacks, pearls and gems from the water 3× as often

jeweler.name: Jeweler
jeweler.blurb: Cut the gems miners find and set them in rings and amulets that every class can wear.
perks: Light touch: 15% chance to save a material
Masterwork: jewelry can come out Masterwork (+30% stats)
Crown jeweler: learn the diamond and voidglass recipes
Steady cut: 25% chance to keep the gem
Flawless: +12% masterwork chance

RULES.choose: Chosen when the character is made ('How do you want to play?'): adventurer or artisan, plus any number of professions (an artisan must pick at least one; default smith + fisher). Saved as P.path ('adventurer' | 'artisan') and P.prof.mains.
RULES.change: Can be switched later only at a Guild Registrar (Professions panel > 'Become an Artisan' / 'Become an Adventurer'). Switching sets peace to match the path.
RULES.peace: P.peace: null = follow the path, true/false = player override. peaceOn() = P.peace === true || (P.peace == null && path is artisan).
RULES.peaceful: With peace on, a monster ignores the player unless it was provoked (the player hit it first) and it is not a dungeon, raid, king's quest, arena, ghost, PvP or summoned add monster: peacefulFor(m) = peaceOn() && !m.provoked && !m.d.dung && !m.d.dungeon && !m.d.raid && !m.kqm && !m.arenaFoe && !m.ghostOf && !m.pvp && !m.add.
RULES.levelling: Adventurers level by fighting; artisans level through their professions, and the Artisan's Road (AROAD) is their quest line instead of the combat story.
